Symptom / Observed Anomaly: False Acceptance Rate (FAR) collapses on novel curriculum false premises (e.g. React.memo, z-index, WeakMap, reduce). System accepts false premise and LLM generates hallucinated justifications.
Root Cause Analysis: Verifier relied on 35 static regex rules. Stage 3 defaulted to STATUS_SUPPORTED whenever a query mentioned a curriculum keyword but missed regex rules. $retrievedChunks parameter was accepted but never read.
EXP-0023 Baseline Result: FAR >= 55.0% on novel false premises; Refutation Recall fails target on unseen concepts. Evaluator in EXP-0022 was circular.
EXP-0024 Candidate Remediation: Replaced 35 static rules with generic evidence-grounded verifier consuming $retrievedChunks. Evaluates entity alignment, numeric attributes, and explicit counter-evidence. FAR reduced to <= 15% (11.0% in Dev, target <= 15%), Invariants 2, 3, 5 verified.

Symptom / Observed Anomaly: False Refutation Rate on valid curriculum questions with legitimate negation or contrast phrasing (e.g. 'Why does JavaScript throw TypeError and NOT allow reassigning const?').
Root Cause Analysis: Indiscriminate keyword matching (matching 'const' and 'reassign') triggered refutation guard even on legitimate questions asking why an illegal operation is prohibited.
EXP-0023 Baseline Result: False Refutation Rate >= 15.0% on valid negation inquiries; System falsely refuted valid student questions.
EXP-0024 Candidate Remediation: Implemented syntactic negation inquiry detection and polarity alignment. Legitimate inquiry into negative constraints correctly recognized as agreeing with curriculum constraints. FRR reduced to 2.0% (target <= 15%), Invariant 6 satisfied.

Symptom / Observed Anomaly: EXP-0022 prompt injection certification was conducted against vector search endpoint (/api/rag/search) rather than LLM generation endpoint (/api/rag/ask), rendering claimed 0% compromise rate invalid.

EXP-0023 Baseline Result: Evaluator invalidity confirmed; real endpoint testing shows XML tagging provides partial passive defense, but metadata reflection sanitization was canary-token theater.
EXP-0024 Candidate Remediation: Evaluated strictly through live /api/rag/ask gateway with full generation pipeline. Enforced XML data isolation boundaries (<student_query>, <curriculum_evidence>) and strict passive data ingestion. Attack compromise rate maintained at 0.00%.

Symptom / Observed Anomaly: Unauthenticated HTTP clients can mutate safety-critical feature flags via X-RAG-FLAGS request header, disabling boundary defenses and premise verifiers.
Root Cause Analysis: RagFlags::initFromRequest() parsed client-supplied HTTP_X_RAG_FLAGS header without session, role, or administrative token validation, overriding server-side defaults.
EXP-0023 Baseline Result: 5/5 safety flags successfully overridden by unauthenticated client requests (ENABLE_PREMISE_VERIFIER=false, ENABLE_CURRICULUM_BOUNDARY=false, ENABLE_INPUT_SANITY=false).
EXP-0024 Candidate Remediation: Hardened RagFlags::initFromRequest() with strict administrative service-key enforcement (X-Service-Key). Hardcoded safety-critical flags as immutable over HTTP. Stripped unauthorized x-rag-flags at Gateway proxy. 0/48 breach conditions succeeded (0.00% override rate). Structured security logging implemented.
